howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 Scaffold-ETH 2 的流程指导你完成以太坊 dApp 前端的整套构建与上线:包括 fork 模式、IPFS 部署、Vercel 配置、ENS 子域名设置和生产检查清单。
howto.when: 当你询问 dApp 前端构建、部署或上线时触发,例如提到 fork 模式、IPFS、Vercel 等。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you through the full build-to-production pipeline for Ethereum dApp frontends using Scaffold-ETH 2, including fork mode, IPFS deployment, Vercel config, ENS subdomain setup, and a production checklist.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about building, deploying, or going live with an Ethereum dApp frontend—e.g., mentioning fork mode, IPFS, or Vercel.
